# ravenna_status_group (Data Source)

Look up a Ravenna status group by label. Status groups are managed by Ravenna and cannot be created, changed or deleted through the API, but `ravenna_ticket_status` requires one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Status groups are managed by Ravenna and cannot be created through the API.
data "ravenna_status_group" "open" {
  label = "Open"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) Status group label to look up, for example `Open` or `Pending`.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) Status group colour.
- `id` (String) Status group identifier.
- `order` (Number) Display order.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace that owns the status group.
